CLMA No. 5207/2017 (Substitution Application) 
In 
SA No. 25 of 2017
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J. None 
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Standing Counsel 
for the State/respondent. 
The sole appellant since has been 
passed away hence, this substitution 
application. 
It is hereby allowed. 
Let the amended memo be 
presented by the end of this month. 
Respondent no. 1 is still unserved , 
wherefor, steps shall also be taken within 
the time indicated above. 
List this matter soon after the 
service is affected. (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)

CLMA No. 10745/2018 (Substitution Appl)
In 
S.A. No.25 of 2017
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mrs. Anjali Bhargava, Brief Holder 
for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, Advocate for 
respondent no. 1. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties. 
Substitution application, being 
unopposed by the learned counsel for 
the respondents, is allowed. 
Let necessary substitution be 
incorporated within a period of one 
week from today. 
List this matter on 05.09.2018. 
Interim order dated 21.02.2017 to 
continue till then. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
Arpan 26.07.2018
